hero.sub: CallMeIE is an AI phone receptionist for Dublin businesses. It answers your phone 24/7 in a natural Irish accent, books appointments straight into your diary, and texts back every missed caller within a minute. Irish-built — so a smaller Dublin business can cover the phone like a firm ten times its size.

sections.title: Compete with the big Dublin desks — without the wage bill
sections.dek: In a market as crowded as Dublin, the business that answers wins. CallMeIE covers your line every hour of every day, so a missed lunchtime or after-six call doesn't become a booking for the firm down the road.
sections.body: Dublin is the most competitive market in the country, and reception staff cost more here than anywhere else in Ireland — which is exactly why so many small Dublin businesses let calls ring out to voicemail and lose them. A customer in Sandyford, Tallaght, Swords, Dún Laoghaire or the city centre who can't get an answer doesn't wait; they ring the next result on Google. CallMeIE closes that gap for a fraction of a Dublin front-desk salary: every call answered 24/7 in a natural Irish accent, appointments booked straight into your diary, and every missed caller texted back inside a minute. It's Irish-built and run in-house — setup is done remotely, so there's no travel and no offshore call centre, and your caller data is never sold on.

sections.title: What it handles for a Dublin business
sections.dek: Six jobs, one system, working the hours a Dublin front desk can't. Not a generic chatbot — a receptionist that happens to be software.
sections.body:
I — Answer

Answers every call, 24/7

Lunchtime, after six, weekends, bank holidays — covered. Callers get a real conversation, not a voicemail beep, so they book instead of ringing a competitor.

II — Book

Books into your diary

Reads your Google Calendar live, quotes a real slot, confirms the appointment — no double-booking, no "we'll call you back".

III — Text back

Missed-call text-back (60s)

Any call that still rings out gets an SMS within a minute offering to book or answer a quick question. No Dublin lead goes cold.

IV — Qualify

Takes the details that matter

Name, number, reason, urgency — captured every time and waiting for you, instead of a half-remembered note.

V — Escalate

Forwards the urgent ones

Genuinely urgent calls route straight to your mobile, with an SMS summary at the same time. You set the rules.

VI — Report

Monday morning summary

A plain email each Monday: calls taken, appointments booked, missed-call recoveries, top questions this week. Ninety seconds.

sections.title: Built for Ireland, not for "UK & Ireland"
sections.dek: The specifics that come up on a real Dublin call. Generic global-AI receptionists fail on every line in this list.
sections.body:
• Irish accentsTuned and tested against real Irish caller recordings across Leinster and beyond. Strong accents are understood, not bounced to a menu.
  • 01 & mobile formatsHandles 01 landlines and 085/086/087/089 mobiles interchangeably — no rejected numbers.
  • Bank holidaysSt Patrick's Day, Easter Monday, the May/June/August bank holidays, October, Christmas and St Stephen's Day — auto-respects your closure calendar.
  • GDPRCall data processed under a Data Processing Agreement, EU infrastructure, recordings deleted on a fixed schedule. Caller data is never sold.
  • Keep your numberWe sit behind your existing 01 line via call forwarding — your customers ring the number already on your card and Google listing.
  • Gaeilge availableOpt-in bilingual greeting and booking for businesses that want it.

sections.title: From €149/month. One setup fee. No lock-in.
sections.dek: Most Dublin businesses start on the entry tier and move up only if call volume needs it. Month-to-month, cancel anytime — €149/mo is the starting price, not a flat rate.
sections.body: Pricing starts at €149/month plus a one-time setup fee, with higher tiers adding 24/7 after-hours cover, missed-call text-back, SMS confirmation on every booking, and a knowledge base built from your own services. No minimum seat count and no annual contract on the entry tiers — start small, see the missed-call recoveries land, and move up only if the volume justifies it. The fastest way to judge it is to ring the live line on +353 61 788 120 and hear exactly what your own callers would hear.
